column1: Traffic reports will resume on Thursday, May 15 at 4 p.m.

column4: The roadway is shut down in both directions until further notice between Yarnallton Pike and Browns Mill Rd due to a collision involving a semi that struck the RR overpass and lost its load (tractor).
Detours in place via Browns Mill Rd, S Yarnallton Pike, and Old Frankfort Pike.
Estimated duration until 4 p.m. or later.  Motorists should expect delays or avoid the area if possible.
